observations.behavior: Removes clamping of requested start_date to a documented 90-day search horizon.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows warehouse ingestion to request historical payments older than Checkout.com's advertised default; this could recover missing long-tail transaction history without changing connector behavior.

observations.behavior: Replaces silent completion and warning logging with an exception when the per-run API budget is exhausted mid-range.
observations.posthog_connection: Makes incomplete backfills visible as errors rather than invisible completed states, enabling recovery and preventing schema status mismatches during large historical imports.

observations.behavior: Adds the new marker string to the set of recognized transient/retryable error markers.
observations.posthog_connection: Connects the payment-source failure mode into PostHog's broader scheduling and alerting system so that partial runs are retried instead of treated as terminal failures.

observations.limitations: Only one checkout-com source implementation shown. No tests demonstrate end-to-end recovery or checkpoint resumption. Documentation changes do not establish actual customer benefit.

review.limitations: Only one checkout-com source implementation shown. No tests demonstrate end-to-end recovery or checkpoint resumption. Documentation changes do not establish actual customer benefit.
review.reason: Changes remove a documented-but-incorrect clamp on start dates, introduce explicit handling for budget exhaustion, and register that condition as retryable. This improves reliability and reachability of warehouse ingestion but does not change query planning or cross-component architecture.
review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse ingestion could recover older transaction history; scheduler can distinguish this from other failures; no tier 3 systemic risk reduction demonstrated.
review.uncertainty: Assessment relies only on supplied hunks; complete behavior depends on surrounding orchestration and test execution.
